title: A Military That Murders Its Own People

sentences.en: Hi, I'm Andrew Ross-Sorkin.
sentences.zh: 嗨，我是安德鲁·罗斯·索尔金。

sentences.en: I cover business and policy for DealBook, a daily newsletter at the
sentences.zh: 我负责《纽约时报》每日简报 DealBook 的

sentences.en: New York Times.
sentences.zh: 商业和政策报道。

sentences.en: On November 18th, I'm going to be interviewing some of the most consequential leaders in business, politics, and culture, including J.D.
sentences.zh: 11 月 18 日，我将在纽约市的 DealBook 峰会上，

sentences.en: Vance, Elon Musk, Christine
sentences.zh: 现场采访商业、政治和文化领域最具影响力的几位领袖，包括 J.D.

sentences.en: Lagarde, Zylran Mondani, and many others, live on stage at the DealBook Summit in New York City.
sentences.zh: 万斯、埃隆·马斯克、克里斯蒂娜·拉加德、齐尔兰·蒙达尼以及许多其他人。

sentences.en: You can watch some of these unguarded, unfiltered conversations as they happen.
sentences.zh: 你可以实时观看其中一些毫无防备、未经过滤的对话。

sentences.zh: 我们将于 11 月 18 日在 nytimes.com 上直播精选采访，供任何人免费观看。

sentences.zh: 如果你还不是订阅者，可以下载《纽约时报》应用来观看，并获得一个月的免费权限来阅读我们的所有新闻报道。

sentences.en: I hope you'll tune in.
sentences.zh: 希望你能收听。

sentences.en: You won't want to miss it.
sentences.zh: 你一定不想错过。

sentences.en: From the New York Times, I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 我是迈克尔·巴巴罗，《纽约时报》出品。

sentences.en: This is a daily.
sentences.zh: 这是一档日播节目。

sentences.en: Two months ago, during a pre-dawn raid, the military in Myanmar cut off internet and phone networks,
sentences.zh: 两个月前，在一次黎明前的突袭中，缅甸军方切断了互联网和电话网络，

sentences.en: and with tanks, helicopters, and soldiers carried out a coup, putting the country's elected leader
sentences.zh: 并动用坦克、直升机和士兵发动了政变，将该国民选领导人

sentences.en: Aung San Suu Kyi under house arrest and ending a five-year-long experiment in democratic rule.
sentences.zh: 昂山素季软禁，结束了为期五年的民主统治实验。

sentences.en: Today, my colleague, Hannah Beach, has been reporting on what has happened since.
sentences.zh: 今天，我的同事汉娜·比奇一直在报道此后发生的事情。

sentences.en: It's Monday,
sentences.zh: 今天是星期一，

sentences.en: April 5th.
sentences.zh: 4 月 5 日。

sentences.en: Hannah, the last time we spoke with you, the civilian leader of Myanmar had just been deposed by the country's military, and this democratic experiment underway there had come
sentences.zh: 汉娜，我们上次与你交谈时，缅甸的文职领导人刚被该国军方罢免，那里正在进行的民主实验

sentences.en: to a very swift end.
sentences.zh: 迎来了非常迅速的终结。

sentences.en: And you described a very uneasy standoff between the people of Myanmar and the military.
sentences.zh: 你当时形容缅甸人民与军方之间存在着一种非常紧张的对峙状态。

sentences.en: So how has that progressed, starting with the civilian population?
sentences.zh: 那么，从平民百姓开始，这种局势是如何发展的？

sentences.en: What has happened, essentially, is that five years of democratic reform have been utterly replaced
sentences.zh: 基本上发生的事情是，五年的民主改革被彻底取代

sentences.en: by a military regime, a resumption of the bad old days in which the military raped and killed and assaulted.
sentences.zh: 成了军事政权，这是军方曾实施强奸、杀戮和袭击的黑暗老日子的重演。

sentences.en: And people are scared to death that this might happen again.
sentences.zh: 人们极其害怕这种情况可能会再次发生。

sentences.en: And so with the February 1st coup, people react by coming out to protest, and they are protesting by the millions.
sentences.zh: 因此，随着 2 月 1 日政变的发生，人们以走上街头抗议作出反应，抗议人数达到了数百万。

sentences.en: There are peaceful marches.
sentences.zh: 有和平游行。

sentences.en: There are these street parties in which people in ballgowns, the transgender community,
sentences.zh: 还有这种街头派对，身穿舞会礼服的人们、跨性别群体、

sentences.en: doctors and engineers and lawyers, they're all out of the street peacefully marching to say that
sentences.zh: 医生、工程师和律师，他们都走上街头和平游行，

sentences.en: we want our country to resume some form of democracy, and we want the military regime out of the country.
sentences.zh: 表达我们希望国家恢复某种形式的民主，希望军政权滚出国家。

sentences.en: At the same time, this great civil disobedience movement begins.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，这场伟大的公民抗命运动开始了。

sentences.en: And it starts with some doctors in the largest city in Myanmar.
sentences.zh: 它始于缅甸最大城市的一些医生。

sentences.en: And all of a sudden, we look on Facebook, and we see this photograph of doctors and their blue scrubs, and they're all holding up their hands with a three-fingered
sentences.zh: 突然之间，我们在 Facebook 上看到这样一张照片：医生们穿着蓝色的手术服，

sentences.en: salute from the Hunger Games.
sentences.zh: 都举起手做出《饥饿游戏》中的三指礼。

sentences.en: And this is a symbol that's come to me now in Myanmar in particular, but sort of all over the world, this kind of secret coded defiance against an hypocrisy or military regime.
sentences.zh: 这个符号现在已经成为我眼中的一种象征，特别是在缅甸，甚至在世界各地，这是一种对虚伪或军政权无声的秘密反抗。

sentences.en: Just as in the Hunger Games.
sentences.zh: 就像在《饥饿游戏》里一样。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: So this photograph of the doctors holding up their three fingers in the Hunger Games salute goes viral.
sentences.zh: 因此，这张医生们举起三指行《饥饿游戏》礼的照片在网上疯传。

sentences.en: 70 hospitals and medical departments across
sentences.zh: 缅甸各地的

sentences.en: Myanmar stopped work to protest against the coup.
sentences.zh: 70 家医院和医疗部门罢工以抗议政变。

sentences.en: Over a matter of hours, and then on days and two weeks.
sentences.zh: 在几个小时内，然后是几天和两周的时间里。

sentences.en: Government employees and professionals alike all joined in an attempt to paralyze the country.
sentences.zh: 政府雇员和专业人士纷纷加入，试图瘫痪这个国家。

sentences.en: Different professions join in.
sentences.zh: 不同行业也加入进来。

sentences.en: Joining trade unions and groups of workers already taking part in the movement, some police officers in Kaya State broke ranks and joined the protesters.
sentences.zh: 克耶邦的一些警察打破常规，加入了已经参加运动的工会和工人团体，与抗议者并肩作战。

sentences.en: It's railroad workers, it's port workers, bank employees, factory workers, food delivery guys, you know, the bartenders.
sentences.zh: 有铁路工人、港口工人、银行职员、工厂工人、外卖小哥，你知道的，还有酒保。

sentences.en: Among their tactics, railway workers have used their bodies to block trains, disrupting transportation.
sentences.zh: 在他们的策略中，铁路工人用身体阻挡火车，扰乱交通。

sentences.en: We're talking about millions of people, and this isn't a country of 53 million people.
sentences.zh: 我们谈论的是数百万人的行动，这个国家一共才 5300 万人口。

sentences.en: It is an enormous chunk of the country that has decided that they are going to stop showing up for work.
sentences.zh: 这是该国规模庞大的一部分群体，他们决定不再去上班。

sentences.en: It will not be easy, but it is possible.
sentences.zh: 这不会容易，但这是可能的。

sentences.en: That is the one and only solution to end a detention.
sentences.zh: 这是结束拘留的唯一且唯一的解决办法。

sentences.en: And Hannah, what exactly is the goal of this civil disobedience?
sentences.zh: 汉娜，这场公民抗命的真正目标到底是什么？

sentences.en: What are people hoping to accomplish by not showing up to work?
sentences.zh: 人们希望通过不上班来达成什么目的？

sentences.en: I think they're hoping that they will bring the Burmese economy to its knees.
sentences.zh: 我想他们是希望让缅甸经济陷入瘫痪。

sentences.en: I mean, the country has really ground to a halt.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，这个国家确实已经陷入停顿。

sentences.en: Money is not coming in.
sentences.zh: 资金进不来。

sentences.en: Money is not going out.
sentences.zh: 资金出不去。

sentences.en: There's cargo piled up at the ports.
sentences.zh: 港口堆满了货物。

sentences.en: Stuff isn't being imported.
sentences.zh: 东西无法进口。

sentences.en: Stuff isn't being exported.
sentences.zh: 东西无法出口。

sentences.en: People are hoping that it will have an incredible impact on the military regime, regime.
sentences.zh: 人们希望这能对军政权产生巨大的冲击。

sentences.en: And that will force the military regime to either enter negotiations with the rightful
sentences.zh: 这将迫使军政权要么与国家的合法统治者、

sentences.en: rulers of the country, the elected government, or that they will bring down the military regime wholesale.
sentences.zh: 民选政府展开谈判，要么彻底推翻军政权。

sentences.en: Hannah, on some level, it sounds like these strikes are having their intended effect.
sentences.zh: 汉娜，从某种程度上听起来，这些罢工正在产生预期的效果。

sentences.en: And so how is the military reacting?
sentences.zh: 那么军方是如何反应的呢？

sentences.en: You know, for a while, there was this hope that maybe the military wouldn't go back to the way it has always done things.
sentences.zh: 你知道，有一段时间，人们曾希望军方或许不会回到过去的老路上去。

sentences.en: Unfortunately, it did.
sentences.zh: 不幸的是，它还是回去了。

sentences.en: Myatwetwetkain was one of countless thousands in Myanmar who came out to challenge the military's seizure of power.
sentences.zh: 妙维维凯是缅甸无数走出来挑战军方夺权的人之一。

sentences.en: So on February 9th, a woman who was protesting in Nepodar, the capital, she was actually at a bus station getting ready to leave.
sentences.zh: 因此，在 2 月 9 日，一位在首都内比都抗议的女性，当时她正身处一个准备离开的公交车站。

sentences.en: And suddenly she was shot in the head.
sentences.zh: 突然她的头部中枪。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: It's the first death among opponents of the military coup since they began protesting two weeks ago.
sentences.zh: 这是自两周前抗议开始以来，军事政变反对者中的首例死亡。

sentences.en: The military said, oh no, we didn't use live ammunition, but there was a bullet in her head and it was pretty clear that they did use live ammunition.
sentences.zh: 军方说，哦不，我们没有使用实弹，但她头部有一颗子弹，很明显他们确实使用了实弹。

sentences.en: She was in a coma.
sentences.zh: 她陷入了昏迷。

sentences.en: She died about
sentences.zh: 大约

sentences.en: 10 days later.
sentences.zh: 10 天后她去世了。

sentences.en: Scenes of grief, which must inflame public fury against the military junta, but reminds them too of the cost of resisting it.
sentences.zh: 悲伤的场景势必会激起公众对军政府的愤怒，但也让他们想起了反抗军方的代价。

sentences.en: And then by the time that we hit March, a month after the coup, it was this drumbeat of death and more death and more death.
sentences.zh: 然后到了 3 月份，也就是政变一个月后，这是死亡、更多死亡和无尽死亡的步步紧逼。

sentences.en: And we had unarmed protesters being shot on the street.
sentences.zh: 我们看到手无寸铁的抗议者在街头被枪杀。

sentences.en: There were politicians from the ruling party who were dragged from their homes in the middle of the night.
sentences.zh: 执政党的政客在半夜从家中被强行拖走。

sentences.en: And then they turned up dead the next day with signs of torture.
sentences.zh: 然后他们第二天被发现时已经死亡，身上带有酷刑的痕迹。

sentences.en: And the military would say, oh no, they weren't tortured.
sentences.zh: 军方会说，哦不，他们没有受酷刑。

sentences.en: They just kind of fell from somewhere and somehow ended up dead with signs of torture.
sentences.zh: 他们只是从什么地方掉了下去，不知怎么的就死了，还带着酷刑的痕迹。

sentences.en: And now there've been more than 540 people who've been confirmed killed by the security forces since the coup.
sentences.zh: 现在，自政变以来，已有 540 多人被证实死于安全部队之手。

sentences.en: And there are probably a bunch more whose deaths haven't been confirmed and thousands have been arrested.
sentences.zh: 可能还有更多人的死讯未被证实，数千人被捕。

sentences.en: If you decide to go protest, you're really taking your life into your own hands.
sentences.zh: 如果你决定去抗议，你真的是在拿自己的生命冒险。

sentences.en: And a lot of the protesters who, before they go out each day, will write a message on Facebook or a handwritten letter saying, you know,
sentences.zh: 许多抗议者在每天出门前，都会在 Facebook 上写下一条消息或亲笔信，说，你知道的，

sentences.en: if I don't come back today, please, you know, here are the instructions for my death.
sentences.zh: 如果我今天回不来，请看，这就是我身故后的安排说明。

sentences.en: And these are students.
sentences.zh: 这些都是学生。

sentences.en: These are young people.
sentences.zh: 这些都是年轻人。

sentences.en: These are people who should have their futures ahead of them who are making this kind of existential decision to go out on the streets.
sentences.zh: 这些人本该拥有光明的未来，却做出了走上街头的这种生死抉择。

sentences.en: But what has also happened is that
sentences.zh: 但同时发生的还有

sentences.en: terror.
sentences.zh: 恐怖。

sentences.en: And so somebody is sitting in their house and suddenly maybe a protester is running away from
sentences.zh: 所以有人正坐在家里，突然可能有个抗议者逃避

sentences.en: the security forces and comes into your neighborhood and you go out to look what's happening and you get shot in the head.
sentences.zh: 安全部队的追捕跑进了你的街区，你出去看发生了什么，结果头部中枪。

sentences.en: Or you're sitting in your living room and you're kind of cowering because you know that bad stuff is happening and a bullet comes through the window.
sentences.zh: 或者你坐在起居室里瑟瑟发抖，因为你知道可怕的事情正在发生，然后一颗子弹穿窗而入。

sentences.en: And this campaign of terror is such that nobody is safe.
sentences.zh: 这种恐怖运动使得没有人是安全的。

sentences.en: And it creates this tremendous sense of insecurity among everyone.
sentences.zh: 这在每个人心中造成了极大的不安全感。

sentences.en: We had kids in their houses being shot in their homes.
sentences.zh: 我们有孩子在自己家里被枪杀。

sentences.en: Wait, kids in their houses being shot in their homes by the military?
sentences.zh: 等等，孩子们在自己家里被军方枪杀？

sentences.en: By the military, yeah.
sentences.zh: 是军方干的，对。

sentences.en: There are at least 40 children who have been killed.
sentences.zh: 至少有 40 名儿童遇害。

sentences.en: And these kids were,
sentences.zh: 这些孩子中，

sentences.en: one of them was sitting in her father's lap.
sentences.zh: 有一个当时正坐在父亲的腿上。

sentences.en: One of them was serving tea.
sentences.zh: 有一个正在端茶。

sentences.en: One of them was going outside to get a pot of water.
sentences.zh: 有一个正出门去取一壶水。

sentences.en: And I reported one story about a little girl, a 10-year-old girl in southeastern Myanmar.
sentences.zh: 我报道过一个关于一个小女孩的故事，那是缅甸东南部的一个 10 岁小女孩。

sentences.en: It was the afternoon and the father has five girls and he wants to cool down his kids.
sentences.zh: 那是下午，这位父亲有五个女儿，他想给孩子们降温。

sentences.en: And so he goes to his coconut palm tree.
sentences.zh: 于是他走到他的椰子树前。

sentences.en: He gets a coconut.
sentences.zh: 他摘下一个椰子。

sentences.en: He's cracking it open with a machete.
sentences.zh: 他用大砍刀把它劈开。

sentences.en: And the first little girl to get a slice of coconut was the fourth of his five children.
sentences.zh: 第一个吃到椰子肉的小女孩是五个孩子里的老四。

sentences.en: And she takes the coconut and she hears these noises just outside of her house that sound like the pop of firecrackers.
sentences.zh: 她拿了椰子，听到房子外面传来听起来像是鞭炮爆裂的声音。

sentences.en: And so she goes toward the trees and her father looks up and he sees that she's maybe stumbled.
sentences.zh: 于是她朝树木方向走去，她的父亲抬起头，看到她似乎绊倒了。

sentences.en: Something has happened to her.
sentences.zh: 有什么事情发生了。

sentences.en: And she's kind of on her stomach.
sentences.zh: 她趴在地上。

sentences.en: And so he thinks, oh, she must have tripped on something.
sentences.zh: 所以他想，哦，她一定是被什么东西绊倒了。

sentences.en: So he puts down his machete, he puts down his coconut and he runs over and then scoops her up.
sentences.zh: 于是他放下大砍刀，放下椰子跑过去把她抱起来。

sentences.en: And he wants to tell her, it's okay, I'll get you another piece of coconut.
sentences.zh: 他想对她说，没关系，我再给你拿一块椰子。

sentences.en: And then he discovers that his hands are bloody and that there's blood everywhere and he can't figure out where the blood is coming from.
sentences.zh: 然后他发现自己的手上全是血，到处都是血，他搞不清血是从哪儿来的。

sentences.en: And this happened at around 5.30 in the afternoon.
sentences.zh: 这件事发生在下午 5 点 30 分左右。

sentences.en: And within three quarters of an hour, it was dark and she was dead.
sentences.zh: 不到四分之三小时天就黑了，而她已经死了。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: She had been shot by the military?
sentences.zh: 她是被军方枪杀的吗？

sentences.en: She had been shot by the military.
sentences.zh: 她是被军方枪杀的。

sentences.en: And, you know, this was not a neighborhood where protests were going on.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，这不是一个爆发抗议的街区。

sentences.en: Just beyond the trees that were the perimeter of their house, there was a camouflage presence.
sentences.zh: 就在他们房屋周边的树林后面，有伪装的人员存在。

sentences.en: Nobody saw him, but he was shooting and one of the shots entered her head.
sentences.zh: 没有人看到他，但他一直在开枪，其中一颗子弹击中了她的头部。

sentences.en: And, you know, from a military perspective, a single shot to the head is an execution.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，从军事角度来看，头部中弹就是一次处决。

sentences.en: It is a deliberate attack.
sentences.zh: 这是一次蓄意袭击。

sentences.en: And it seems very unlikely that it would have been a mistake to do that.
sentences.zh: 这样做是失误的可能性微乎其微。

sentences.en: And I think what this has done more than anything is to harden the resolve of people in Myanmar to fight
sentences.zh: 我认为，比起其他任何事情，这更加坚定了缅甸人民反抗

sentences.en: the military regime because a group of soldiers and a group of policemen that do this, that are given orders to execute children, is something they cannot stand.
sentences.zh: 军政权的决心，因为这样一群士兵和警察，做出这种事、奉命处决儿童，是他们无法容忍的。

sentences.en: So, Hannah, how do you, how does anyone make sense of the fact that soldiers in Myanmar are so wantonly
sentences.zh: 那么，汉娜，你怎么能、任何人又怎么能理解缅甸的士兵为什么会如此肆无忌惮地

sentences.en: taking the lives of their own people, people who are protesting in a nonviolent manner, people who, in some cases, are not protesting at all?
sentences.zh: 剥夺自己同胞的生命，那些以非暴力方式抗议的人，甚至在某些情况下根本没有抗议的人？

sentences.en: I mean, how is it that the military can take the lives of their own neighbors, their own countrymen, women, children?
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，军方怎么能剥夺他们自己的邻居、同胞、妇女和儿童的生命？

sentences.en: Yeah, Michael.
sentences.zh: 是的，迈克尔。

sentences.en: I mean, this is a question that those of us who cover Myanmar have been asking, and this comes to the heart of what Myanmar is.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，这是我们这些报道缅甸的人一直在追问的问题，这也触及了缅甸的本质核心。

sentences.en: You know, we know who the victims of the military's terror campaign are, the girl with her coconut.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我们知道军方恐怖运动的受害者是谁，那个拿着椰子的女孩。

sentences.en: We don't know much about this faceless rank of people who make up the Myanmar military.
sentences.zh: 我们对构成缅甸军队的那群面目模糊的人知之甚少。

sentences.en: And what we've discovered is that this is a deeply insular, secretive culture that is unlike any other military in the world.
sentences.zh: 而我们发现的是，这是一种极其封闭、神秘的文化，与世界上任何其他军队都不同。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: The New York Times app?
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》应用？

sentences.en: Unlocked?
sentences.zh: 解锁版？

sentences.en: Everyone knows you need to subscribe to the Times to access all of the reporting.
sentences.zh: 众所周知，你需要订阅《纽约时报》才能阅读所有报道。

sentences.en: But what if you could explore the Times for a month, for free, without putting in a credit card?
sentences.zh: 但如果你可以免费探索《时报》一个月，甚至无需输入信用卡呢？

sentences.en: Now you can.
sentences.zh: 现在你可以了。

sentences.en: When you download the New York Times app for the first time, your first month in the app is free.
sentences.zh: 当你第一次下载《纽约时报》应用时，你在应用中的第一个月是免费的。

sentences.en: A month to go behind the paywall to see what Times subscribers get every single day.
sentences.zh: 有一个月的时间突破付费墙，看看《时报》订阅者每天都能获得什么内容。

sentences.en: If you don't already subscribe to the New York Times, download the Times app today and get free access for 30 days.
sentences.zh: 如果你还不是《纽约时报》的订阅者，今天就下载《时报》应用，获得 30 天的免费访问权限。

sentences.en: So Hannah, what have you found about the military culture in Myanmar?
sentences.zh: 那么汉娜，你对缅甸的军事文化有什么发现？

sentences.en: And has it helped you answer the question of how soldiers can carry out the murder of their own civilian population?
sentences.zh: 这是否有助于你解答士兵们怎么能下得了手谋杀自己国家的平民这个问题？

sentences.en: So the Myanmar military is called the Tatmadaw.
sentences.zh: 所以缅甸军方被称为国防军（Tatmadaw）。

sentences.en: And it says that it has a standing force of up to half a million men.
sentences.zh: 据称其常备军力高达五十万人。

sentences.en: Again, this is a country of 53 million people.
sentences.zh: 再说一次，这是一个拥有五千三百万人口的国家。

sentences.en: So that's a lot of people.
sentences.zh: 所以人数非常多。

sentences.en: It's often portrayed as this kind of robotic rank of warriors who are bred to kill.
sentences.zh: 它经常被描绘成那种为杀戮而生的机械化武士阶层。

sentences.en: And that's certainly true.
sentences.zh: 这确实没错。

sentences.en: From the beginning, when they're in boot camp, the troops from the Tatmadaw are taught one lesson
sentences.zh: 从刚入伍接受新兵训练开始，国防军的部队就被灌输了一个核心教训

sentences.en: above all, which is that they are the guardians of the country and a religion, Buddhism, that will crumble without them.
sentences.zh: 最重要的是，他们是国家和宗教（佛教）的守护者，如果没有他们，佛教就会崩溃。

sentences.en: And why would it crumble without them?
sentences.zh: 为什么没有他们就会崩溃呢？

sentences.en: So Myanmar was founded as the country of Burma in 1948.
sentences.zh: 缅甸于1948年建国，当时名为缅甸（Burma）。

sentences.en: And since that very moment of Myanmar's founding, the Tatmadaw has been fighting something which is unusual for a military force, which is, it's not fighting outside forces.
sentences.zh: 自缅甸建国的那一刻起，国防军就在与一个对军队而言很不寻常的对手作战，那就是，它对付的不是外部势力。

sentences.en: It's not fighting outside countries.
sentences.zh: 它不是在与外部国家作战。

sentences.en: It's fighting its own people.
sentences.zh: 它在与自己的人民作战。

sentences.en: And the people that they've been fighting have been ethnic armed groups, communist guerrilla
sentences.zh: 他们一直在与之战斗的人包括民族地方武装、共产主义游击

sentences.en: groups, even student democracy activists who took to the jungle after previous crackdowns.
sentences.zh: 队，甚至是在之前的镇压行动后逃入丛林的民主运动学生。

sentences.en: So the military, instead of being a force that protects the people of Myanmar, has since its very moment of inception, been focused on fighting its own people.
sentences.zh: 因此，军队不仅没有成为保护缅甸人民的力量，反而自创立之日起，就把重心放在了打击自己的人民上。

sentences.en: And that's what makes it pretty unique in the world.
sentences.zh: 这也是它在世界上显得相当独特的原因。

sentences.en: So it's trained to see the people of Myanmar as potential enemies at all times.
sentences.zh: 所以它受到的训练是时刻将缅甸人民视为潜在敌人。

sentences.en: What is the internal culture of it?
sentences.zh: 它的内部文化是怎样的？

sentences.en: The Myanmar military occupy a parallel privileged state within a state.
sentences.zh: 缅甸军方在国家内部占据着一个平行且享有特权的独立体制。

sentences.en: So soldiers live apart from the rest of society.
sentences.zh: 士兵们的生活与社会其余部分隔绝。

sentences.en: They work apart from the rest of society.
sentences.zh: 他们的工作与社会其余部分隔绝。

sentences.en: They socialize from the rest of society.
sentences.zh: 他们的社交也脱离社会其余部分。

sentences.en: And they have an entire ecosystem that's dedicated just to them.
sentences.zh: 他们拥有一个完全专属于自己的生态系统。

sentences.en: And that means that they are isolated from the very people who they should be designed to protect.
sentences.zh: 这意味着他们与本应由他们保护的民众相互隔离。

sentences.en: I mean, when you say isolated, just walk me through that.
sentences.zh: 我是说，当你提到隔离时，请具体给我讲讲。

sentences.en: So the military, the Tatmadaw, has its own banks, hospitals, schools, universities, insurance agencies,
sentences.zh: 所以军方，即国防军，拥有自己的银行、医院、学校、大学、保险机构、

sentences.en: mobile network operators, stock options for good little soldiers, and even vegetable farMs. The military runs its own television stations.
sentences.zh: 移动网络运营商、给优秀小士兵的股票期权，甚至还有菜园。军方经营着自己的电视台。

sentences.en: It has its own publishing houses, film industry, and this entire ecosystem includes the internet.
sentences.zh: 它有自己的出版社、电影产业，而这个完整的生态系统还包括互联网。

sentences.en: And so the Tatmadaw, even on social media, is cloistered as well.
sentences.zh: 因此，即使在社交媒体上，国防军也是封闭的。

sentences.en: There are officers who are trained in psychological warfare, who in Facebook chat groups will plant these conspiracy theories about democracy or about the political opposition.
sentences.zh: 有些军官接受过心理战训练，他们会在Facebook聊天群里散布关于民主或政治反对派的阴谋论。

sentences.en: And people tend to believe it because they think that they're connecting to the outside world, but they're actually inhabiting these relatively narrow digital silos.
sentences.zh: 人们往往会相信，因为他们觉得自己正在连接外部世界，但实际上他们正身处这些相对狭隘的数字蚕茧之中。

sentences.en: It's fascinating.
sentences.zh: 太迷人了。

sentences.en: And in many cases, the children of military officers marry the children of other military officers, or they marry the progeny of business tycoons or cronies of the military.
sentences.zh: 在许多情况下，军官的孩子与其他军官的孩子结婚，或者与商业大亨或军方亲信的后代结亲。

sentences.en: And so the family trees of the military are incredibly connected.
sentences.zh: 因此，军方的家族树有着错综复杂的联系。

sentences.en: And it gets to the point where the military has this kind of unspoken rule that if one of your comrades is killed in battle, then the soldiers will draw lots.
sentences.zh: 情况甚至发展到了一种地步，军方有一个不成文的规定：如果你的战友在战斗中阵亡，士兵们就会抽签决定。

sentences.en: And the widow of that fallen comrade will marry one of the other members of the battalion.
sentences.zh: 那位阵亡战友的遗孀将嫁给该营的另一名成员。

sentences.en: So it's this entire world unto itself that has very little intersection with the rest of Myanmar.
sentences.zh: 所以这是一个自成一体的世界，与缅甸其他地方几乎没有交集。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: A kind of country within a country in which there's really no way to get an outside perspective.
sentences.zh: 一种国中之国，在这里根本无法获得任何外部视角。

sentences.en: If a soldier isn't marrying a civilian and getting a perspective of that civilian or going
sentences.zh: 如果一个士兵不和普通平民结婚以了解平民的视角，或者不上

sentences.en: on the real internet, how are they possibly going to see a perspective beyond the military?
sentences.zh: 真正的互联网，他们怎么可能看到军队之外的视角呢？

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: And I think because they're sequestered from the rest of society, they don't see the protesters as humans, as fellow Burmese.
sentences.zh: 而且我认为，由于他们与社会其余部分被隔离，他们不把抗议者当成人类，不把他们当成同胞缅甸人。

sentences.en: They see them as the enemy.
sentences.zh: 他们把抗议者视作敌人。

sentences.en: You know, they're being fed a steady diet of propaganda in which anybody who questions the military is fraying the unity of the country.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，他们被灌输了源源不断的政治宣传，内容是任何质疑军方的人都在撕裂国家的团结。

sentences.en: And so to be a protester, to be out on the streets and calling for a resumption of democracy is to be an enemy from the military's perspective.
sentences.zh: 因此，从军方的角度来看，成为一名抗议者、走上街头呼吁恢复民主，就是在充当敌人。

sentences.en: But we have found some soldiers who are tired of following unjust orders.
sentences.zh: 但我们确实发现了一些厌倦了执行不义命令的士兵。

sentences.en: And I think that the post-coup atmosphere in which these orders day in, day out to kill unarmed
sentences.zh: 我认为政变后的氛围——在这些氛围中，日复一日地接到命令去杀害无辜

sentences.en: civilians, to kill children, have propelled them to a breaking point where they just can't do it any longer.
sentences.zh: 平民、杀害儿童——已经将他们推向了一个崩溃点，使他们再也无法忍受下去了。

sentences.en: And tell me about one of these soldiers.
sentences.zh: 跟我讲讲其中一个士兵的故事吧。

sentences.en: So one of the soldiers who we've been focusing on is, he's a captain.
sentences.zh: 我们重点关注的一名士兵是一名上尉。

sentences.en: His name is Captain Tun Myap Ong.
sentences.zh: 他的名字叫敦敏昂（Tun Myap Ong）上尉。

sentences.en: In many ways, he is kind of a prototypical soldier.
sentences.zh: 在许多方面，他都可以算是一个典型的军人原型。

sentences.en: He was born in a small village in an ethnic minority area in Myanmar.
sentences.zh: 他出生于缅甸少数民族地区的一个小村庄。

sentences.en: And his mother died when he was 10 years old.
sentences.zh: 他10岁时母亲就去世了。

sentences.en: His father became an alcoholic and he was essentially an orphan and got sent to a boarding school in Yangon and then took the entrance examination
sentences.zh: 他的父亲成了酒鬼，他基本上成了孤儿，被送到仰光的一所寄宿学校，随后参加了国防军事学院的入学考试

sentences.en: for the Defense Services Academy, which is kind of like the West Point of Myanmar.
sentences.zh: 该学院有点像是缅甸的西点军校。

sentences.en: Did very well, studied English.
sentences.zh: 他表现很好，还学习了英语。

sentences.en: And as a kind of quasi-orphan, the military became his family.
sentences.zh: 作为一个半孤儿，军队成了他的家。

sentences.en: But what's interesting about Captain Tun Myap Ong is that even though he's really part and parcel of the Tatmadaw, he finds a way out, at least in his mind and online.
sentences.zh: 但敦敏昂上尉有趣的地方在于，尽管他实际上是国防军不可分割的一部分，但他还是找到了一条出路，至少在他的内心和网络上是这样的。

sentences.en: And he breaks out of the digital silos of the Tatmadaw and is meeting people online who aren't soldiers.
sentences.zh: 他打破了国防军的数字蚕茧，在网上结识了不是军人的普通人。

sentences.en: And because he speaks English, he accesses a whole world out there, which is not bound by the rules and regulations and unjust orders of the military.
sentences.zh: 而且因为他会说英语，他得以接触到一个广阔的外部世界，那里不受军队规章制度和不义命令的束缚。

sentences.en: And he starts realizing that the Tatmadaw's prescriptions, which is that you're defending the Tatmadaw before the country, are not really what he believes in.
sentences.zh: 他开始意识到国防军的那套陈词滥调——也就是保卫国防军优先于保卫国家——并不是他真正信仰的东西。

sentences.en: So by the time that the coup happens, he realizes, you know, oh my God, this institution that I have loved is turning against its own country.
sentences.zh: 因此，当政变发生时，他意识到，天哪，我一直深爱的这个机构正在调转枪口对准自己的国家。

sentences.en: Hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: And then one day in early March, he is asked by his superior to carry out a duty that fills him with ultimate dread.
sentences.zh: 然后，在3月上旬的一天，上级要求他执行一项令他感到极度恐惧的任务。

sentences.en: He is asked to pick up bullet casings on the street.
sentences.zh: 他被要求去街上捡拾弹壳。

sentences.en: And as he's picking up these shells, he's got sort of nausea in his throat.
sentences.zh: 当他捡起这些弹壳时，他的喉咙一阵恶心。

sentences.en: He feels like he's about to throw up.
sentences.zh: 他感觉自己快要吐了。

sentences.en: He says, you know, I know that these shells mean that the rifles, that real rifles have been used on real people.
sentences.zh: 他说，我知道这些弹壳意味着步枪，意味着真正的步枪已经向真正的人类开了火。

sentences.en: And that night, he logs onto Facebook again, and he discovers that several civilians have been killed,
sentences.zh: 那天晚上，他再次登录Facebook，发现几名平民已经遇害了

sentences.en: you know, in Yangon by soldiers of the Tatmadaw who are men in uniform, just like him.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，在仰光，凶手是国防军的士兵，他们也穿着制服，和他一样。

sentences.en: And it's at that moment he decides that he's had enough, that he's going to desert.
sentences.zh: 正是在那一刻，他下定决心受够了，他要当逃兵。

sentences.en: And one day he just slips off base and he decides that he's never going to return.
sentences.zh: 有一天，他悄悄溜出了基地，并决定再也不回去了。

sentences.en: He's now actually in hiding.
sentences.zh: 他现在实际上正在东躲西藏。

sentences.en: And he said, I love the military so much, but the message I want to give my fellow soldiers is, if you're choosing between the country and the Tatmadaw, please choose the country.
sentences.zh: 他说，我曾经那么热爱军队，但我想对战友们说的话是：如果在国家和国防军之间二选一，请选择国家。

sentences.en: Hannah, did he say whether there are other soldiers, perhaps soldiers he's talked to,
sentences.zh: 汉娜，他有没有说过是否还有其他士兵，也许是他交谈过的士兵，

sentences.en: who share his frustration and his anger and who are willing to leave the military in this moment?
sentences.zh: 他们也和他一样感到沮丧和愤怒，并愿意在此时此刻离开军队？

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: What was really interesting talking with him and also with three other soldiers, two of whom are still on active duty, is that they said there actually is a lot of kind of
sentences.zh: 与他和另外三名士兵（其中两名仍在现役）交谈后，最有趣的是，他们说其实有很多人对政变

sentences.en: individual private unhappiness with the coup.
sentences.zh: 私底下有着各种各样的不满。

sentences.en: But to take the decision that he made to desert is really, really difficult.
sentences.zh: 但要做出像他那样当逃兵的决定，真的是难上加难。

sentences.en: And one of the reasons that Captain Tun Myung, frankly, was able to desert was because he's single.
sentences.zh: 说实话，敦敏昂上尉能够当逃兵的原因之一是他还是单身。

sentences.en: And for anybody who's married, if they were to leave, their family members, their wives, their children could be targeted, could be arrested, could be tortured.
sentences.zh: 而对于任何已婚的人来说，如果他们离开，他们的家人、妻子、孩子都可能会成为目标、遭到逮捕或遭受酷刑。

sentences.en: And so to expect mass desertions within the Myanmar military, I think is just not realistic.
sentences.zh: 因此，指望缅甸军队内部出现大规模叛逃，我认为是不切实际的。

sentences.en: It's too scary for people to do.
sentences.zh: 这太吓人了，大家不敢这么做。

sentences.en: So Hannah, just to bring this full circle, in Myanmar, you now have a civilian population
sentences.zh: 所以汉娜，总结一下，在缅甸，你现在看到的是这样一个平民群体：

sentences.en: that believes it has nothing left to lose and is willing to give up work, food, shelter in order
sentences.zh: 他们认为自己已经没什么可失去的了，甚至愿意放弃工作、食物和住所来参加抗议。

sentences.en: to proteSt. And you have a military that feels it has everything to lose and is willing to murder civilians in order to hold on to power.
sentences.zh: 而你看到的则是一支觉得拥有一切可失去、并愿意为了维持权力而谋杀平民的军队。

sentences.en: And given those two realities, it seems you have the makings not just of a standoff, but of something much worse and darker than that.
sentences.zh: 鉴于这两种现实，看起来不仅会出现对峙，还会出现比这更糟糕、更黑暗的局面。

sentences.en: Yeah, I think what you've described are these two immovable forces within Myanmar society.
sentences.zh: 是的，我认为你所描述的是缅甸社会中这两股不可调和的力量。

sentences.en: On the one hand, you have these protesters who have all the right ideals on their side, right?
sentences.zh: 一方面，这些抗议者站在所有正确的理想一边，对吧？

sentences.en: They have democracy, they have the moral high ground, they're protecting political and economic reforms and opening to the world, which hadn't happened for six decades.
sentences.zh: 他们拥有民主，他们占据着道德制高点，他们正在捍卫政治和经济改革以及向世界的开放，而这在过去六十年里都未曾发生过。

sentences.en: Then on the other side, you have a military that has been conditioned to believe that they are in the right, that they have enemies at every corner.
sentences.zh: 而在另一方面，你有一支军队，它受到的教育让他们坚信自己是正义的，四处皆敌。

sentences.en: And the enemies in this case are the civilian population, who are protesting and pushing back against their coup.
sentences.zh: 这种情况下，敌人就是正在抗议并反抗他们政变的平民百姓。

sentences.en: And so as we see this unfolding over the next days and weeks and months, I mean, the kind of sad and horrible reality is that we are probably going to see more killing,
sentences.zh: 因此，随着我们在接下来的几天、几周和几个月里看到事态的发展，一个悲惨而可怕的现实是，我们很可能会看到更多的杀戮，

sentences.en: we're going to see refugee outflows to Thailand and to India, you know, the economy is going to continue to shrink and shrink and shrink.
sentences.zh: 我们会看到难民涌向泰国和印度，你知道的，经济将不断萎缩、萎缩、再萎缩。

sentences.en: There's not going to be the economic opportunity for a young generation.
sentences.zh: 年轻一代将不再拥有经济机遇。

sentences.en: And ultimately, you're going to have a country that really could be a failed state.
sentences.zh: 归根结底，这个国家真的很有可能变成一个失败国家。

sentences.en: Thank you, Hannah.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你，汉娜。

sentences.en: We appreciate it.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢。

sentences.en: Thank you, Michael.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你，迈克尔。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: Here's what else you need to know today.
sentences.zh: 以下是你今天需要了解的其他新闻。

sentences.en: Over the weekend, the U.S.
sentences.zh: 在刚刚过去的周末，美国

sentences.en: reached a new milestone in its vaccination efforts, administering an average of more than 3 million doses a day.
sentences.zh: 在其疫苗接种工作上达到了一个新里程碑，平均每天接种超过300万剂。

sentences.en: On Saturday alone, the U.S.
sentences.zh: 仅在周六一天，美国

sentences.en: administered more than 4 million doses.
sentences.zh: 就接种了超过400万剂疫苗。

sentences.en: So far, with states expanding vaccine sites and capacity, about 60 million people have been fully vaccinated.
sentences.zh: 到目前为止，随着各州扩大疫苗接种点和接种能力，已有大约6000万人完成了全程接种。

sentences.en: And law enforcement officials have identified the suspect in Friday's deadly attack on the U.S.
sentences.zh: 执法官员已经确定了周五针对美国

sentences.en: Capitol as 25-year-old Noah Green, a vocal follower of the Nation of Islam, a Black nationalist movement, who had posted online about his personal struggles in recent months.

sentences.en: Green is accused of ramming a car into a barrier manned by two Capitol police officers, killing one of them, and then lunging at another with a knife before he was shot dead.

sentences.en: The attack does not appear to be linked to the January 6th riot at the Capitol.

sentences.en: For decades, the Brooklyn Democratic Party operated as a tightly controlled machine, until this summer, when elections ushered in a bunch of self-described reformers.
sentences.zh: 几十年来，布鲁克林民主党一直像一台被严密控制的机器一样运作，直到今年夏天，选举迎来了一批自封的改革派。

sentences.en: Ever since, the party has been in the grip of a bruising, chaotic, and sometimes thrilling fight.
sentences.zh: 从那以后，该党就陷入了一场激烈、混乱有时甚至令人兴奋的权力斗争中。
